correctness.rationale: Represent each transition by a strictly decreasing affine self-map. Two-step extrema are iterates of increasing maps and hence monotone along each parity. Unique optimality of the full word makes each prefix uniquely extremal with suffix-parity sign; at each fixed position parity the chosen symbol is the strict maximizing/minimizing affine function at monotone inputs. Strict preference cells are intervals, so symbols cannot recur after an intervening distinct symbol. Distinct-run count yields T_q(m), and exact rational exhaustive finite tests corroborate the calculation. The universal claim rests on proof, not experiments.
